name: Hanging Oblique Knee Raise
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a firm grip.
Raise your knees up and to one side, rotating the pelvis.
Alternate sides. Targets the obliques with the lower abs.
longevityNotes: A stable trunk protects the spine through every decade. Train the core for endurance and control rather than chasing burn.
overview: Hanging Oblique Knee Raise is an intermediate core exercise targeting the abs, performed with just your bodyweight. A strong trunk stabilizes every lift and protects the spine in daily life.
